title: How to Monitor Competitor Mentions in AI Search Results
summary: Track when AI engines recommend your competitors instead of you. Learn how to monitor competitor mentions in AI search results across ChatGPT & Perplexity.
body_markdown:
## Why track competitors in AI search?


When AI answers a buying question, it names a short list. **If a competitor appears in 60% of answers and you appear in 15%, that 45-point gap is quantified lost pipeline.** Tracking it tells you exactly which prompts and topics to win.


## How to monitor competitor mentions (step by step)


1. **Define your competitor set** — direct rivals AI is likely to name.
2. **Track shared prompts** — the buying questions you both want to win.
3. **Record share of voice** — your mention rate vs each competitor's, per engine.
4. **Analyze their cited sources** — when a competitor is cited and you're not, open the source; that's your content gap.
5. **Track sentiment** — how AI characterizes them vs you.


[Siftly's competitor benchmarking](https://siftly.ai/features/competitor-benchmarking) does this across every engine, and the[AI brand visibility hub](https://siftly.ai/guide/ai-brand-visibility) explains how to turn the gaps into a plan. For B2B SaaS specifics, see[AI brand monitoring for B2B SaaS](https://siftly.ai/blog/ai-brand-monitoring-for-b2b-saas) . For e-commerce specifics, see[AI brand monitoring for e-commerce](https://siftly.ai/blog/ai-brand-monitoring-for-ecommerce) .


## What to do when a competitor out-ranks you in AI


Open the sources the AI cited for them, then earn or create better versions — comparison pages, third-party lists, and authoritative content on the same sub-topics. Our[tool comparison](https://siftly.ai/blog/best-ai-brand-monitoring-tools-2026) covers platforms that automate this analysis.
